preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The number of friends N for each test case must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] < i for i in range(1, N + 1))
preconditions.description: Each A[i] must be a non-negative integer less than i.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal number of steps required for each test case.
